settings.spread_policy: observed ask - bid from each tick; no additional spread
settings.commission_note: not modelled by the engine; price-term PnL

strategy.name: Candle Direction
strategy.description: Close > Open -> LONG, Close < Open -> SHORT. Signal tradable after candle close.
strategy.logic: Close > Open -> LONG; Close < Open -> SHORT; Close == Open -> no signal. Signal available at the source candle close (bar start + timeframe).

execution_contract.long_entry: ASK of the first tick at/after signal availability
execution_contract.short_entry: BID of the first tick at/after signal availability
execution_contract.end_of_data: open position closed at the last tick's BID (LONG) / ASK (SHORT)
